summary: Removed the "intro", "details", and "verify" steps, cutting the funnel from 6 steps to 3, because each extra step before email collection drops ~20–40% of users and deferring the ask until after two content pages was the largest single source of abandonment.

Changed the landing page from a bare, friction-heavy welcome screen to a clean card layout with a benefit-focused headline, removed the "read carefully first" friction, and replaced the weak "Learn more" link with a direct "무료로 시작하기" (Start for free) CTA plus trust-reducing micro-copy ("no credit card · 30-second signup"), which removes the two biggest conversion blockers: unclear value and fear of commitment.

Added a social proof block with stacked avatar icons and a "14,000명+ 이미 함께" user count above the CTA button, because showing that many others have already signed up reduces perceived risk and triggers herd behavior, which reliably lifts conversion rates.

Added 3 specific benefit bullets (time savings, unified dashboard, data security) between the headline and the CTA, because naming concrete outcomes answers the visitor's "what do I get?" objection — the primary reason people leave a landing page without signing up.

Added a specific 5-star customer testimonial with a named persona directly above the CTA, because concrete social proof with a relatable quote and real-sounding name converts significantly better than just a user count alone.

Added a time-limited offer banner ("이번 주만 — 프리미엄 플랜 30일 무료") at the top of the card, because urgency and a concrete bonus reward trigger loss-aversion and push undecided visitors to sign up immediately rather than leaving to "think about it later."
